VghLantern__Specification__Config.VghLantern__Specification__Config__Descr: System configuration for the Specification mode. Merged over VghLantern__AppConfig__Main__.json by AppCore ConfigLoader and read back through ConfigLoader.GetSection('Specification'). Section order, table columns and rounding all live here - no schedule column is ever hardcoded in a renderer.

VghLantern__Specification__Config__Docum.AggregateWhenMultiLanternNote: With more than one lantern on a project the schedule prints a per-lantern breakdown plus an aggregated works-order summary. A single lantern prints the breakdown only.
VghLantern__Specification__Config__Docum.DocumentMaxWidthNote: A4 portrait width (210 mm) plus 20%. Keeps the on-screen specification reading as a document column rather than a full-bleed web page.
VghLantern__Specification__Config__Docum.EmptyStateMessage: Select a lantern in the Lantern Editor to derive a specification.

VghLantern__Specification__Config__Secti.Label: Glazing Areas
VghLantern__Specification__Config__Secti.EnabledNote: Off since v0.10.0. Adam, 20-Oct-2026: 'remove this ... per side is irrelevant its the total of all of the panels'. The glass area is now each roof glazing unit's m2 and the total glass in Roof Glazing Panel Units. Preview and Send's specification page drops its area table with this switch, so true brings both back.

VghLantern__Specification__Config.VghLantern__Specification__Config__Secti: Renderer keys map to a builder in DocumentModel. Adding a section requires a matching builder; an unknown Renderer is skipped with a console warning rather than breaking the document.

VghLantern__Specification__Config__Table.LinearColumnsNote: The purchasing table for one lantern. Section width and height were dropped because the profile reference already fixes the section - two numbers off a swept profile describe its bounding box and nothing a buyer acts on. Material carries the specification decision the reference alone does not read out: timber, aluminium or lead.
VghLantern__Specification__Config__Table.AggregateLinearColumnsNote: The project roll-up printed under Project Total - All Lanterns. Stated rather than derived from LinearColumns by filtering, because it reports a different quantity: every lantern combined, not one lantern, so it carries LengthMTotal and drops the per-lantern member count.
VghLantern__Specification__Config__Table.CuttingListColumnsNote: The workshop table. Section Lengths answers how much stock to buy; this answers what to cut it into, so cut length and number off lead rather than a run total.

VghLantern__Specification__Config__JobNo.PlaceholderText: Job-specific notes for the workshop and the client...
VghLantern__Specification__Config__JobNo.AutosaveDebounceMsNote: Notes write into the project file, which triggers an autosave. Debounced so typing a paragraph is one save rather than one per keystroke.
VghLantern__Specification__Config__JobNo.HelperText: Notes print on the specification document and on every drawing sheet.

VghLantern__Specification__Config__Glazi.Description: The glazing department's sheet for each lantern (v0.10.0): a simplified top-down plan with a circular RU (Roof glazing Unit) bubble on every glazing panel, and one row per panel type with its straight-on cut drawing, code, quantity, cut sizes and glass build-up. Built by VghLantern__Specification__GlazingSchedule from the glazing panel layout, ONLY when the Specification tab shows its Glazing Panels section or the pack prints its Glazing Schedule page, and cached per lantern state.
VghLantern__Specification__Config__Glazi.OnDemandNote: Adam, 20-Oct-2026: 'Ensure these arent generated until that tab is entered though as to not waste compute so only compute the glass panel drawings diagram and table when the specf section opens and as a failsafe when the end pack is compiled'.
VghLantern__Specification__Config__Glazi.RoundSizesDownNote: Adam, 20-Oct-2026: cut sizes and edge lengths are rounded DOWN to the whole millimetre, so a pane is never listed bigger than it was designed and the 3mm clearance stays at least 3mm. false rounds to the nearest millimetre instead.
VghLantern__Specification__Config__Glazi.SquareCornerToleranceNote: A corner within this of 90 degrees is square and is not annotated; every other corner prints its cut angle.
VghLantern__Specification__Config__Glazi.FontFamilyNote: Helvetica leads because the PDF draws in jsPDF's Helvetica; Arial is metrically identical, so the screen sets the same advances.
VghLantern__Specification__Config__Glazi.DimensionColourNote: The first rank dimension red the drawings use, so a cut size reads as a dimension.

Plan.MaxSizeNote: The plan is fitted inside this box, not drawn to a scale, and is never wider than the narrowest document paper's body (A4 portrait, 186mm).
Plan.BubbleSizeNote: Every bubble is one size: the smaller of the tightest panel's inscribed circle times BubbleFillFactor and the largest bubble the tightest panel holds on its line (a corner triangle, where the line meets the hip) times BubbleLineFitFactor, held between the two radii.
Plan.BubbleLineNote: Adam, 20-Oct-2026: 'Set all bubbles in consistent lines'. Each slope's bubbles sit on one line parallel to its eaves, this many bubble radii in from the eaves edge (a row above a transom lines up above the transom), each centred along the line in its own panel. A panel that cannot hold its bubble on the line keeps it at the panel's pole.
Plan.Caption: Roof glazing panel unit plan, not to scale. Front at the bottom; one bubble per unit, coded by unit type.

Drawing.CellNote: Each panel type is fitted into this box (not to scale; every size is dimensioned), and the box is the drawing column of the schedule on screen, in the preview and in the PDF.
Drawing.StepNote: The dashed line is where the sealed unit stops short of the eaves extrusion upstand; only the top pane runs on below it (the stepped edge).
Drawing.AngleNote: An angle prints on its corner's bisector, inside the glass, as far in as its label needs to clear both edges and the arc; a corner too tight for that (a sliver, a short cut) prints it just outside the corner instead.
Drawing.BreakNote: A panel that would be drawn narrower than MinDrawnWidthMm when fitted to the cell (a long narrow pane) is drawn at that width with its plain middle taken out and shown as a break, the way a long member is drawn: the cut ends keep their true shape and angles, and every size printed is the full one. The break comes out of the run above the eaves step where both sides are upright and nothing is cut, keeping BreakKeepMm of plain glass either side of it.

Page.PageNote: The pack's Glazing Schedule page is laid out once, in millimetres, and the preview and the PDF both draw that layout, so they break their pages in the same places. A panel row is the drawing cell's height plus RowPaddingMm above and below it; a row never splits, and the table heading repeats on every page the table runs onto.
Page.HeaderHeightNote: Room for a two-line column heading, as 'Glass Thickness' takes on A4 portrait.
Page.SecondaryTextNote: The second line of a cell (the sealed unit's size under the top pane's, the panes under the glass type) prints this much smaller than the value, in --Vale_TextSecondary.
Page.CellNote: Adam, 20-Oct-2026: 'put Code Qty Length mm Width mm Glass Type Glass Thickness Cavity Spec at the top of each feintly and then centre the main text and make it a little larger'. Every text cell of a panel row carries its column's name faintly at its top, and its value set larger, centred in the row's height. The Specification tab sizes the two relative to its own type; the pack page and the PDF use these millimetres.

VghLantern__Specification__Config__Glazi.TableColumnsNote: The drawing column is a fixed width so every cut drawing is the same size; the rest share what is left by Weight, so A3 document paper widens the text columns, not the drawings. Length and Width are the top pane's, with the sealed unit's beneath when it differs.
VghLantern__Specification__Config__Glazi.ProvisionalNote: * Provisional typical glass build-up until Vale's glazing panel design confirms it.
VghLantern__Specification__Config__Glazi.NoBuildUpNote: Printed in the thickness and cavity columns when the lantern's glazing spec has no build-up in VghLantern__Glazing__Options__Config__BuildUps.
VghLantern__Specification__Config__Glazi.EmptyMessage: This lantern has no roof glazing panel units to schedule.
VghLantern__Specification__Config__Glazi.PageTitleNote: Adam, 20-Oct-2026: 'call the section "Roof Glazing Panel Units"'. The Specification tab's section, the pack page's title, its Preview and Send switch and its page caption all carry the one name.
VghLantern__Specification__Config__Glazi.AreaNote: Adam, 20-Oct-2026: 'have a square m2 0.00m2 column for each and have a total glass 0.00m2 value at the end, per side is irrelevant its the total of all of the panels'. The Area column is one unit's top pane (the sealed unit's beneath where it differs), to the nearest 0.01 m2, its unit in the column heading as Length mm and Width mm are; the total row closing the table is every unit on the lantern, summed from the exact areas. The old per-slope Glazing Areas section is switched off.
